head: e7a462f4ad04d3d6793f29eeecea690749769171

unanimous_findings: no fixed interface contract, so F8's A/B could not score both arms with the same tests
no sha256 manifest, so pre-registered artifacts could be tuned during RHL-1..12

findings: 14 term contracts declared phantom Kani harnesses — the practice this PR files KANIDEBT-1 against
Cargo.toml include omitted the gates' data files, so a packaged crate could not run them
task 01 named runner-01 and registered no host: an arm advantage hidden in a fixture
rounds.outcome: all fixed; the fixture finding was generalised into a gate that then caught three more (tasks 24, 25, 29)

findings: M3: moving `pub` off Program made the whole F1 gate green on a grammar with Amendment A1's ambiguity restored
M4: a grammar whose only production is Phrase = WORD+ passed every check while parsing no RHL at all
M1/M2: the gate's stated reason for discarding LALRPOP's error was false — a conflict and a typo render differently
M7: two of twelve valid break programs did not parse, taking ten planted breaks with them
M8: the unit GB lexed as nothing, so §3.1 principle 4's own example was an InvalidToken
M10: Amendment A1's claim to be 'the only' repair was false
rounds.method: the lane GENERATED A PARSER from grammar/rhl.lalrpop and ran the committed corpus through it — something no gemini lane did
rounds.outcome: all fixed except M6, recorded as spec open question O1 because the obvious repair reintroduces an LR conflict

agreed_basis: Every finding from all three rounds is fixed and independently re-measured by the author before commit, except M6 which is recorded as spec open question O1 with both candidate repairs and their LALRPOP reports, for the operator to rule. Two model families are represented, per S5.
s5_evidence: This ticket is the first measured case for family diversity: three gemini lanes unanimously passed a grammar gate that could be switched off two different ways, and the claude lane found both by building a parser instead of reading one. Recorded in paiml-implement#298.
residuals: F1's second half — every corpus program has exactly one parse — needs a generated parser and is RHL-1's work.

Only 4 of 40 corpus tasks have been audited for arm fairness. RHL-8 must audit the rest BEFORE the A/B, and the corpus is frozen at merge: a later fix goes v0 -> v1 with a public diff and a manifest re-hash.
Spec open question O1: three lines of §3.2 do not parse; the operator rules between the two recorded repairs.
